opportunities.title: Resubmit lignin-rich upholstery foams with fire-safety and 50,000-cycle durability evidence
opportunities.one_line: Reviewers asked for EN 13501 fire data and a durability benchmark; recent polyol routes raise lignin content.

claims.text: A reviewer found that the proposal did not demonstrate EN 13501 fire safety at the proposed bio-content.

evidence_refs.quote: The applicants do not demonstrate that the foams meet fire-safety standard EN 13501 at the proposed bio-content.

claims.text: Another reviewer asked for a durability comparison with commercial petroleum-based foams over at least 50,000 compression cycles.

evidence_refs.quote: The durability plan lacks a comparison with commercial petroleum-based foams over at least 50,000 compression cycles.

claims.text: Your preliminary foams with 15 % lignin already reached a compression set below 10 %.

evidence_refs.quote: Preliminary foams with 15 % lignin reached a compression set below 10 %.

claims.text: You have published how lignin type and content influence the foaming dynamics and properties of flexible polyurethane foams.

evidence_refs.quote: Lignin Type and Content Influence the Foaming Dynamics and Properties of Flexible Polyurethane Foams

claims.text: Lignin's heterogeneity, poor solubility and limited reactivity hinder high-lignin polyurethane foams, and a eutectic-like polyol platform has been reported to address this.

evidence_refs.quote: Replacing petroleum-derived polyols with lignin in polyurethane foams is essential for increasing renewable carbon utilization but is hindered by lignin’s heterogeneity, poor solubility, and limited reactivity.
Here, we report a hydrogen-bond-engineered, eutectic-like polyol platform based on polyethylene glycol (PEG) and salicylic acid (SA), with ethylene carbonate (EC) as a cosolvent

claims.text: 1731 works since 2021 match 'lignin polyurethane foam flame retardant', so fire performance of lignin foams is a crowded topic and the resubmission must state what is new.

readiness_checklist.item: Lignin fractions characterised by 31P NMR and GPC
Preliminary foams with 15 % lignin and compression set below 10 %
50,000-cycle benchmark against a commercial petroleum-based foam

next_steps: Book EN 13501 reaction-to-fire tests for the 15 % and 30 % lignin foams
Run a 50,000-cycle compression benchmark against a commercial foam
Rewrite the aims around fire safety and durability for the next call

opportunities.title: Sulfonated cellulose nanofibre separators for zinc-iodine flow cells beyond 1,000 hours
opportunities.one_line: Your 500-hour cycling data and published membrane put you ahead on a thinly measured separator topic.

claims.text: Your unpublished results show the sulfonated CNF membrane completing 500 hours of cycling at 20 mA cm-2 with coulombic efficiency above 98 %.
Iodide crossover stayed below the UV-vis detection limit after 300 hours of cycling.
You have already published a sulfonated cellulose nanofibre ion-selective membrane for zinc-iodine redox flow batteries.

evidence_refs.quote: Development of a robust ion-selective membrane from sulfonated cellulose nanofibers for zinc–iodine redox flow batteries

claims.text: Cellulose nanofibres already reinforce cellulose acetate membranes, so membrane-grade CNF processing is established.

evidence_refs.quote: In this study, nonwoven membranes were fabricated using cellulose acetate (CA) as the primary component, with varying percentages of cellulose nanofibers (CNFs) embedded as reinforcement.

claims.text: Publications and patents on nanocelluloses have been increasing every year.

evidence_refs.quote: The number of scientific publications and patents concerning nanocelluloses has been increasing every year

claims.text: Only 427 works since 2021 match 'cellulose separator zinc iodine battery', a thin literature for cellulose separators in zinc-iodine cells.
Stability beyond 1,000 hours is still an open question in your own data.

readiness_checklist.item: Flow-cell cycling set-up at 20 mA cm-2
A membrane batch with reduced sulfonation degree

next_steps: Extend the running cells to 1,000 hours with impedance checks every 250 hours
Prepare a lower-sulfonation membrane batch and compare iodide crossover
Draft a short communication on long-duration stability

opportunities.title: Map lignin domains in flexible polyurethane foams with EEM fluorescence
opportunities.one_line: Your fluorescence method for lignin domains in fibre-cement could explain lignin heterogeneity effects in foams.

claims.text: Lignin's heterogeneity, poor solubility and limited reactivity hinder its use as a polyol in polyurethane foams.

evidence_refs.quote: Replacing petroleum-derived polyols with lignin in polyurethane foams is essential for increasing renewable carbon utilization but is hindered by lignin’s heterogeneity, poor solubility, and limited reactivity.

claims.text: You have published EEM fluorescence and DUV Raman analysis of lignin-emissive domains at fibre-cement interfaces.

evidence_refs.quote: Disruption of Lignin-Emissive Domains: Deciphering Fiber–Cement Interfacial Reactions by EEM Fluorescence and DUV Raman Spectroscopy

claims.text: Your proposal aims to relate lignin type and hydroxyl content to foaming dynamics and cell structure.

evidence_refs.quote: Relate lignin type and hydroxyl content to foaming dynamics and cell structure.

claims.text: Only 595 works since 2021 match 'lignin fluorescence fiber cement interface', a small literature for lignin fluorescence methods.

readiness_checklist.item: Lignin fractions characterised by 31P NMR and GPC
SEM and compression data on the foams
EEM fluorescence measurements on foam sections

next_steps: Measure EEM fluorescence on foams made with kraft and organosolv lignin
Correlate fluorescence maps with SEM cell structure
Add the method as a work package in the resubmission

opportunities.title: Antimicrobial lignin-rich flexible foams for upholstery
opportunities.one_line: Antimicrobial lignin foams exist for wound care; your upholstery formulation could add that function.

claims.text: Lignin-based polyurethane foams have been made in a one-step foaming method for antimicrobial wound care.

evidence_refs.quote: Here, we propose a simple one-step foaming method to prepare lignin-based polyurethane foams (LPUFs)
Antimicrobial materials are an urgent need for modern wound care in the clinic.

claims.text: Your proposal targets flexible polyurethane foams with 30 % bio-content from fractionated kraft and organosolv lignin.
High-performance flexible lignin polyurethane foams can be made in one pot with a green co-solvent.

evidence_refs.quote: Green co-solvent-assisted one-pot synthesis of high-performance flexible lignin polyurethane foam

claims.text: Durability against commercial petroleum-based foams over 50,000 cycles is not yet benchmarked.

readiness_checklist.item: Flexible foam formulation with fractionated lignin

next_steps: Screen a silver-free antimicrobial additive in the 15 % lignin foam
Test antimicrobial activity on upholstery fabric standards

opportunities.title: Lightweight magnetic wood panels for EMI shielding
opportunities.one_line: Magnetic and conductive wood scaffolds could give light EMI shielding panels.

claims.text: Porous wood scaffolds loaded with magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles have been used for lightweight EMI shielding.

evidence_refs.quote: hierarchical and porous structured wood is used as the lightweight three‐dimensional organic scaffold for the incorporation of magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles

claims.text: Conductive wood has been developed as a structural EMI shielding material with a load-bearing function.

evidence_refs.quote: Here, we develop a conductive wood as a new type of structural electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding material with combined load-bearing function

claims.text: You have published bio-based magnetic and conductive wood for EMI shielding.

evidence_refs.quote: Sustainable Synthesis of Bio‐Based Magnetic and Conductive Wood for Electromagnetic Interference Shielding Applications

next_steps: Compare panel density and shielding with the published magnetic wood
